legenda: Três amigos entraram em uma vila esquecida e descobriram que a saída cobra um preço terrível. O tempo está correndo e nem todos vão voltar. 😱 Deixe nos comentários qual amigo você sacrificaria para escapar! #terror #suspense #misterio #vilafantasma
falas: We crossed the rusted gates of the ghost village, completely unaware that the exit had vanished behind us.
Every decaying cottage had hot food on the table, yet nobody had lived here for fifty years.
Maya noticed dark silhouettes behind the broken windows, perfectly mimicking every step and breath we took.
When Sam tried to run, the misty cobblestone street unnaturally twisted and threw him back to us.
The ancient clock tower chimed backwards, and with every toll, our reflections in the mud grew older.
A ghostly whisper echoed through the fog, revealing that only two of us would escape by sunrise.
The iron gates finally reopened, but someone must stay forever. Which of your friends would you sacrifice?
